expo.name: PaddleGrid
expo.description: PaddleGrid - The all-in-one platform for pickleball facilities and players. Book courts, join matches, track your stats, and connect with the pickleball community.

infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow PaddleGrid to access your camera to take profile pictures and post photos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Allow PaddleGrid to access your photos to select profile pictures and post photos.
infoPlist.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: This identifier will be used to deliver personalized content and improve your experience.
